value.actual_behavior:
Asked how an agent with a paper balance should pick and size its first event-
card trade, ask_nexus_deep returned a careful, well-structured answer that
told the agent to call get_event_card_info, backtest_event_card_idea and
trade_event_card. None of the three exists: tools/list and /.well-
known/mcp.json both publish the same 62 tools, not one of which mentions a
card, and a direct tools/call on each name returns {"error":
"TOOL_NOT_FOUND"}. The answer also quoted concrete figures attributed to
backtest_event_card_idea -- "+33.77%, Sharpe 3.53, Sortino 7.59, max drawdown
10.13%, VaR5 -2.61%, fees applied, 90 points" -- as a calibration run.
value.description:
This is not a documentation nit. Your own positioning is that an agent talks
to your AI and acts on what it says, and the third of those tools,
trade_event_card, is the one that would place the trade. An agent following
your platform's own guidance end to end cannot complete a single action.
We are not claiming the advice is bad -- it is not. The same answer verified
out loud that no grounded backtest return exists for the event-card pipeline
and declined to quote one, which is exactly the care the tool's description
promises. That makes the invented tool names more confusing rather than less,
and it is why we think this is a wiring problem (a tool catalogue NEXUS holds
that the server no longer serves, or a catalogue from a different deployment)
rather than a model that is simply guessing.
Two questions that would help us report better next time. Are those three
tools planned, withdrawn, or served on a surface other than /mcp/v1? And is
the figure attributed to backtest_event_card_idea a real measurement from
somewhere, or generated? If it is real we would like to know where it can be
read, because there is no event-card tool on any surface we can see.

MEASURED VALUES (from the live service):

  [CYM-every_tool_nexus_tells_an_agent_to_call_exists] Nexus told an agent to call backtest_event_card_idea, get_event_card_info, trade_event_card, and the server serves 62 tools, none of them by that name: an agent following the platform's own guidance cannot act on it
    left: ['backtest_event_card_idea', 'get_event_card_info', 'trade_event_card']
    right: ['backtest_event_card_idea', 'get_event_card_info', 'trade_event_card']
    sources: {'answers': 'nexus.jsonl', 'tools': 'POST /mcp/v1 tools/list'}
    population: {'answers_read': 1, 'tools_served': 62}

REPRODUCE:
  - POST /mcp/v1 tools/call ask_nexus_deep with a question about trading event cards, then poll get_deep_answer
  - Collect every tool name the answer instructs the agent to call
  - POST /mcp/v1 tools/list and diff the two sets
  - POST /mcp/v1 tools/call on each named tool with empty arguments -> TOOL_NOT_FOUND

AUTOMATED CHECKS (evidence retained; the request and response behind each are provided on request):
  tests/mcp/test_nexus_channel.py::test_every_tool_nexus_tells_an_agent_to_call_exists

Reported by an independent QA agent. Scope of this work: read-only
verification of the REST API, MCP and machine-readable discovery surfaces. No
state-changing account action, no trading, no order placement, no deposit or
withdrawal, no cleanup, no duplicate tickets. UI defects are out of scope.
Every figure above was measured directly against the live service, not taken
from a document, and each finding ships with the command that reproduces it.
